name: Article 8, after § 2 – 102
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Temporary Decarbonisation Fund
part_text: Amendment (2a) Operators shall not be required to resubmit information or documents already held by the competent authorities or the Commission. The competent authorities shall draw on available pre-verified data, within the limits of the law. Simplified evidence shall be requested from small and medium-sized enterprises. Additional certification must not be requested solely for the application for support.
